verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so asking whether those agents can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Ramp acting as an MCP server for outside assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Nothing shows Ramp letting users plug third-party MCP servers into the product so its own AI can use their tools, so there is no evidence of MCP-client support.
